main.description: A proposed update to an existing document. Written by an editor or manager to their own PDS. The document owner picks up pending updates via the indexer, applies them, and editor-side cleanup deletes the proposal record after the target's modifiedAt advances past createdAt.

opakeVersion.description: Schema version for the app.opake.* namespace.

document.description: AT URI of the document being updated.

actionType.description: What this update proposes. updateContent: replace the existing blob. updateMetadata: replace the existing encrypted metadata.

blob.description: The updated encrypted content. Required for updateContent.

encryptedMetadata.description: Updated metadata, encrypted with the document's content key. Required for updateMetadata.
